newsitem.title: JAPAN: LME urged to pull out of Long Beach warehouse.
newsitem.headline: LME urged to pull out of Long Beach warehouse.

text.p: Christopher Green, chairman of BZW Metals and Energy Group, called on the LME to pull out of its Long Beach warehousing facility in the U.S. in view of its unsettling effect on the exchange, the International Wrought Copper Council (IWCC) said.
His remarks were made at the 53rd joint meeting between the IWCC and copper producing and marketing companies held in Kobe, Japan, this week, the IWCC said in a statement on Wednesday.
But London Metal Exchange (LME) chairman Raj Bagri rejected this, saying the location served as a springboard for supplies to South East Asia, it added.

Green withdrew an earlier suggestion that LME contracts might switch from the current in-warehouse delivery basis to free-on-truck to overcome concerns about the imbalance of warehouse charges, the industry body said.
